RENOHILL SERIES
The Renohill series consists of moderately deep, undulating, well-drained soils on sedimentary plains. Slopes range from 4 to 8 percent. They formed, in place, in materials weathered from calcareous clay loam and silty clay loam shales at elevations of 3100 to 4000 feet.
The vegetation is mainly western wheatgrass, broom snakeweed, cheatgrass brome, green needlegrass, rubber rabbitbrush, and big sage. Annual precipitation is 13 to 14 inches, mean annual soil temperature is 47 to 49 degrees F., the frost free season is 105 to 115 days.
Typically, the surface layer is light brownish gray silt loam about 2 inches thick. The subsoil is brown silty clay loam and silty clay about 11 inches thick. The substratum is light brownish gray silty clay loam and silty clay resting on clay shale at about 33 inches. A few shale chips occur in the lower substratum.
The permeability is slow and the effective rooting depth is about 33 inches.
These soils are used for range and dry cropland.
A typical profile of Renohill silty clay loam in grass, 1/4 mile east of corral, 310 feet northwest of fence corner in the SW1/4 of Sec. 10, T. 4 S., R. 29 E.
O to 2 inches, light brownish gray (10YR 6/2) heavy silt loam, very dark grayish brown (10YR 3/2) moist; moderate, thin platy structure; slightly hard, friable, slightly sticky and plastic; clear smooth boundary. (2 to 4 inches thick)
2 to 4 inches, grayish brown (10YR 5/2) light silty clay loam, dark brown (10YR 3/3) moist; moderate, medium platy structure; hard, friable when moist, sticky and plastic when wet; clear smooth boundary. (0 to 4 inches thick)
B2t 4 to 10 inches, brown (10YR 5/3) silty clay, dark brown (10YR 4/3) moist; moderate, medium prismatic structure parting to moderate, medium blocks; very hard, firm, very sticky and very plastic; moderately thick patches of clay films coating ped surfaces; clear wavy boundary. (6 to 10 inches thick)
10 to 13 inches, light olive brown (2.5Y 5/3) heavy silty clay loam, olive brown (2.5Y 4/3) moist; moderate medium prismatic structure parting to moderate medium blocks; very hard, firm, very sticky and very plastic; slightly effervescent; a few medium masses of lime; clear wavy boundary.
